concerns.text: FR-004 mandates recording 'exact-match scores AND inference latency'. Task T021 only implements exact-match scores. Task T022 handles latency. If T022 is skipped/delayed, FR-004 is unfulfilled. Split the requirement: T021 must include latency instrumentation or T022 must be merged into T021.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and Spec Assumptions require datasets to be fetched from canonical sources (RepoPeftBench). T055 generates a 'deterministic, local sample repository' to avoid network dependency. This creates a synthetic dataset not traceable to the canonical source, violating the 'Single Source of Truth' and 'Reproducibility' principles unless the sample is explicitly defined as a subset of the canonical data with a checksum.

Plan.md Constitution Check (Principle VII) mandates a 'Paired t-test' as primary, while Spec SC-005 mandates 'Wilcoxon signed-rank test'. T000 acknowledges this but does not resolve it in the plan itself. The plan must be updated to align with SC-005 (Wilcoxon) to ensure the implementation task (T026) has a valid, non-contradictory source of truth.

FR-008 requires handling memory overflow by aborting. T017 (pre-flight) and T043 (runtime) split this into two distinct error codes (E001 vs E003). The spec does not distinguish between pre-flight and runtime checks. This fragmentation risks incomplete coverage if only one path is implemented or tested. Merge into a single coherent memory handling strategy or explicitly map both to FR-008 in the task description.
